ios.desc:
Binarize is the ultimate way to train your binary skills. Play quick rounds that test your binary number recognition and improve your ability in the process.

Choose a number, convert it to binary as quickly as you can, and swipe it off the board. It's that simple! Binarize is an addictive game that'll have you thinking in 1s and 0s in no time.

Includes:
- Three unlockable difficulties to keep things challenging
- Game Center leaderboards: compare scores with your friends and other players around the globe
- iCloud syncing: sync your high scores to all your devices

Binarize is entirely ad-free, collects no creepy data, and is perfect to play offline. With each round just 1 minute long, it's the perfect thing to keep your mind active during downtime.
